sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Sher Bahadur Yadav Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.

By means of the bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No.
120 of 2022 at Police Station- Musajhag, District- Budaun under Sections 498A, 304B, IPC and Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
The applicant is in jail since 01.06.2022.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 29.04.2023.

The following arguments made by Shri Sher Bahadur Yadav, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant, which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Shri Paritosh Kumar Malviya, learned AGA-I from the record, entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
1.
The applicant is the husband of the deceased.

1
2. The applicant never harassed the deceased nor did he demand dowry.
3. The applicant is bereaved by the death of his wife.
4. The deceased was a sensitive lady who was prone to extreme reactions over trivial issues.
5. On the fateful day the deceased took the extreme step of ending her life after petty disagreement over a visit to her parental house.
The deceased committed suicide by hanging.

6. The post mortem report opines that:
(i) The cause of death is asphyxia due to antemortem hanging.
( ii) Hyoid bone was found to be intact.
(iii) Ligature marks were consistent with the hanging.
7. The applicant did not abet or instigate the deceased to commit suicide.
8. The applicant does not have any criminal history apart from this case.
9. The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to cooperate with the court proceedings.
There is no possibility of his influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.
Let the applicant- Omendra be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
(ii) The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

Order Date :- 18.7.2023 Pravin  Omendra vs State Of U.P. on 18 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/140986835/
